intent.t: LESSON 1 (22 Oct 2026, Grade9v3.5): 20+ agents and thousands of lines of code produced no learner output. Repo then: 118 open draft PRs vs 8 merged, 130 open issues, 344 branches. Root cause: no written aim, and process built for a corporate product instead of a personal app for one kid.

knownIssues.t: L1.1 No written aim: each Oracle and agent rebuilt intent from scraps, so goals drifted (bank audit, custody, rights, golden benchmarks, validators) and the plan restarted again and again (Track A, A v2, B, B v2, blueprint-first, question-first replan).

L1.2 Corporate quality bar for a home app: rights, custody, exact-byte reviews, reviewer nominations, fail-closed validators, and 'whole bank proven before any learner sees anything'. For one kid at home a wrong hint is cheap to fix; the gates cost weeks.
L1.3 The kid was never in the loop: no questionnaire, no demand signal. Success was measured by reviews and validators, not by learning.

L1.4 Breadth before depth: 3 subjects x 28 tiles x 8 topics x ~622 questions at once, in giant PRs (PR #299: +616k lines, 451 files, Maths mixed into Physics, 10 checks failing while its text claimed 100%). Not one topic finished end to end.
L1.5 Work never landed: drafts piled up on branches (118 open, 8 merged), so each new agent started from a different base.

L1.6 Coordination ate the effort, OTM included: chat limits forced handovers (Oracle 1 to 3) that lost knowledge; OTM's protocol, the hub and the Progress page grew into projects of their own (22 Oct: most OTM tokens went to hub and page tools, 8 hub checks).
L1.7 Blockers stalled lanes for days: missing Maths source package, missing file receipts, then HOLD ALL.
